title: Lamb Kebabs with Mediterranean Flair
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a mix of Mediterranean herbs and spices.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean seasoning
ingredients.notes: or homemade mix of oregano, thyme, and rosemary

instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a bowl, mix together olive oil, Mediterranean seasoning, garlic, and mint leaves.
Add lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and sprinkle with crushed breadcrumbs.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Serve immediately, garnished with crushed crisp lettuce leaves.
